sections.name: gate
sections.description: Which fragments join a precursor's spectrum (diaPASEF input only)

sections.name: tile
sections.description: Retention-time cells and tiles (diaPASEF input only)

sections.name: perf
sections.description: Speed and memory, diaPASEF input only (the output does not change unless an option says so)

sections.name: charge
sections.description: Isotopes, charge and monoisotope (diaPASEF input only)

sections.name: dnoise
sections.description: MS1 denoising before peak picking (Bruker .d only)

sections.description: Input without ion mobility (Orbitrap, SWATH): a separate extraction path; the other sections do not apply to it

params.name: out_type
params.description: Set the output format instead of taking it from the extension of -out. Empty (default) = follow the extension; an unknown extension gives mzPeak.

params.name: max_charge
params.description: Highest precursor charge considered (diaPASEF input only).

params.name: gate:delta_im
params.description: Largest ion-mobility (1/K0) difference between a precursor and a fragment. It also sets the 1/K0 tolerance of peak picking and tracing; to widen only the fragment match, use gate:fragment_delta_im.

params.name: gate:delta_rt
params.description: Largest apex retention-time difference (seconds) between a precursor and a fragment.

params.name: gate:min_correlation
params.description: Least correlation between the elution profiles of a precursor and a fragment. Raise it for cleaner but sparser spectra.

params.name: gate:min_correlation_points
params.description: Fewest shared points a fragment's correlation needs. Where gate:shrinkage applies, gate:shrink_min_points is used instead.

params.name: gate:short_traces
params.description: Fragment traces too short for a correlation: 'concentric' (default) keeps one whose retention-time span lies inside the precursor's (one frame of slack) and is centred on it; 'off' drops them. Applies to the precursors gate:adaptive selects.

params.name: gate:short_center_tol
params.description: gate:short_traces concentric: how far the fragment's span centre may lie from the precursor's, as a fraction of the precursor's half-span (at least one cycle).

params.name: gate:short_min_points
params.description: gate:short_traces concentric: fewest points a short fragment trace needs.

params.name: gate:fragment_delta_im
params.description: Largest precursor-fragment 1/K0 difference for the fragment match only, leaving the tracing tolerance unchanged. Negative (default) = gate:delta_im. Experimental.

params.name: gate:adaptive
params.description: Which precursors get the extra gate rules (gate:shrinkage, gate:colocation, gate:short_traces). 'faint' (default): only faint precursors, which also use gate:faint_delta_rt and gate:faint_corr_power. 'auto': 'faint' on runs with many faint precursors (gate:auto_faint_fraction), otherwise no extra rules; 'off': the rules apply to every precursor.

params.name: gate:auto_faint_fraction
params.description: gate:adaptive auto: use the faint gate when at least this fraction of the run's precursors are faint.

params.name: gate:faint_max_frames
params.description: gate:adaptive: a precursor with signal in at most this many frames counts as faint.

params.name: gate:faint_delta_rt
params.description: gate:adaptive faint: gate:delta_rt for faint precursors.

params.name: gate:faint_corr_power
params.description: gate:adaptive faint: assembly:corr_power for faint precursors.

params.name: gate:colocation
params.description: 'ranges' (default): keep a fragment only if its apex lies inside the precursor's retention-time span, the precursor's apex inside the fragment's (each with one frame of slack), and the spans overlap by at least gate:colocation_overlap. 'off' skips this test.

params.name: gate:colocation_overlap
params.description: gate:colocation ranges: least overlap of the two spans, as a fraction of the shorter one.

params.name: gate:shrinkage
params.description: 'fisher' (default): pull the correlation of a fragment with few shared points toward a prior (gate:shrink_prior_r, gate:shrink_prior_sd) before the gate:min_correlation test, instead of requiring gate:min_correlation_points points. 'off' uses the plain point count. At the defaults a fragment with at most 4 shared points passes whatever its correlation (docs/options.md, Faint precursors).

params.name: gate:shrink_prior_r
params.description: gate:shrinkage fisher: prior mean correlation.

params.name: gate:shrink_prior_sd
params.description: gate:shrinkage fisher: prior standard deviation in Fisher-z units; smaller pulls harder.

params.name: gate:shrink_min_points
params.description: gate:shrinkage fisher: fewest shared points to compute a correlation (replaces gate:min_correlation_points).

params.name: assembly:min_fragments
params.description: Write a spectrum only if it has at least this many fragments.

params.name: assembly:max_fragments
params.description: Keep at most this many fragments per spectrum, best-ranked first. The twin fold can exceed it. At least assembly:min_fragments.

params.name: assembly:im_weight_sigma
params.description: Weight each fragment's intensity by a Gaussian of its 1/K0 distance to the precursor (sigma in 1/K0), before the fragment cap. 0 = off.

params.name: assembly:corr_power
params.description: Weight each fragment's intensity by corr^k, corr its elution correlation with the precursor. 0 = off.

params.name: assembly:twin_im_tolerance
params.description: Fold spectra that claim the same precursor twice (same charge, m/z within 20 ppm, 1/K0 within this tolerance) into one spectrum with the fragments of both. Negative = off; 0 folds only twins of identical 1/K0.

params.name: assembly:twin_rt_frames
params.description: Also fold twins whose apexes are up to n + 0.5 MS1 cycles apart and in the same retention-time cell, when their precursor m/z lie within 0.05 ppm (one flight-time bin) and charge:mono_profile_check v2 moved one of the two monoisotopes. 0 (default) = auto, from the run's MS1 peak width; -1 = the same MS1 frame only.

params.name: assembly:merge_same_bin
params.description: Merge a spectrum's fragments at the same m/z (one flight-time bin) into one peak before the fragment cap. Two peaks at one m/z break the fragment matching of OpenMS-based search engines.

params.name: assembly:foreign_precursor_weight
params.description: Multiply fragments that lie on the isotope envelope of another precursor isolated in the same window by this weight. 0 (default) removes them; 1 = off. The precursor's own envelope is never touched.

params.name: assembly:foreign_precursor_ppm
params.description: assembly:foreign_precursor_weight: m/z tolerance (ppm) between a foreign envelope position and a fragment.

params.name: assembly:foreign_precursor_dim
params.description: assembly:foreign_precursor_weight: largest 1/K0 difference between this precursor and a foreign one.

params.name: assembly:foreign_precursor_min_iso
params.description: assembly:foreign_precursor_weight: how many of a foreign envelope's four positions (M to M+3) must carry a fragment.

params.name: assembly:fragment_fuse_ppm
params.description: Fuse a spectrum's fragments within this many ppm into one peak (summed intensity, intensity-weighted m/z) before the fragment cap: one fragment ion often shows up as several peaks a few ppm apart. 0 = off.

params.name: trace:mass_error_ppm
params.description: m/z tolerance (ppm) of mass-trace detection.

params.name: trace:noise_threshold_int
params.description: MS1 (precursor) noise level: peaks at or below it are not traced.

params.name: trace:ms2_noise_threshold_int
params.description: MS2 (fragment) noise level: peaks at or below it are not traced.

params.name: trace:min_length_sec
params.description: Shortest MS1 trace kept (seconds, first to last point). Negative (default) = auto: trace:min_length_fwhm times the run's median MS1 peak width, at least half an MS1 cycle; 3 s when the run has too few bright traces to measure the width. 0 = no filter.

params.name: trace:min_length_fwhm
params.description: Auto trace:min_length_sec: the shortest MS1 trace as this fraction of the run's median MS1 peak width.

params.name: trace:ms1_chrom_peak_snr
params.description: An MS1 trace's apex must exceed this times trace:noise_threshold_int.

params.name: trace:ms2_chrom_peak_snr
params.description: A fragment trace's apex must exceed this times trace:ms2_noise_threshold_int. Lower it to keep weaker fragments.

params.name: trace:ms2_min_length_sec
params.description: Shortest fragment trace kept (seconds). 0 = no filter.

params.name: trace:detector
params.description: 'integer' (default) traces on the instrument's flight-time bins and needs the Bruker calibration; without it the run falls back to 'openms' with a warning. 'openms' uses OpenMS MassTraceDetection. The two find partly different peptides; integer uses much less memory.

params.name: trace:ms2_split_valleys
params.description: Split fragment traces at chromatographic valleys; the value is the expected peak width (seconds). 0 = off.

params.name: trace:ms1_split_valleys
params.description: Split precursor traces at chromatographic valleys, so two peptides that elute apart at the same m/z stay separate; the value is the expected peak width (seconds). 0 = off.

params.name: trace:max_span_sec
params.description: Trim each trace to at most this many seconds around its apex. 0 = no limit.

params.name: trace:native_ms1_neighbors
params.description: Add n neighbouring MS1 frames on each side to every MS1 frame before peak picking (Bruker .d with perf:stream_load true). 0 = off. Needs -dnoise:ms1 false.

params.name: trace:im_slice_merge
params.description: Integer detector: before tracing, merge a frame's fragment peaks in one flight-time bin whose 1/K0 values lie within this distance, so one ion does not become several traces. Negative = off.

params.name: tile:rt_sec
params.description: Width (seconds) of the fixed retention-time cells the integer detector traces in; a trace that crosses a cell edge is cut there. 0 or negative = the whole run as one cell. Changes the output.

params.name: tile:cells_per_tile
params.description: Process the run in tiles of this many retention-time cells to bound memory; fewer cells per tile use less memory. 0 = the whole run as one tile, at several times the memory. mzPeak output always runs as one tile.

params.name: diag:spectrum_meta
params.description: Write per-spectrum userParams for diagnosis: spx_p_frames (window frames with precursor signal), spx_faint (1: at most gate:faint_max_frames of them), spx_p_apex (precursor apex intensity).

params.name: diag:dump_ms1_tsv
params.description: Write the MS1 traces and the precursors inferred from them to <prefix>.traces.tsv and <prefix>.precursors.tsv, to see where a precursor was lost. Empty = off.

params.name: perf:malloc_trim
params.description: Return freed memory to the system between phases and tiles (Linux/glibc only). Lowers peak memory at some extra run time; set false when run time matters more.

params.name: perf:stream_load
params.description: Read the input frame by frame (Bruker .d, or mzPeak in a build that supports it; mzML is always read whole). false loads the whole run first: much more memory and a longer run. Changes the output.

params.name: perf:ms1_trace_bands
params.description: Trace MS1 in this many m/z bands in parallel. Changes the output slightly. 1 = off; 0 is read as 1.

params.name: perf:ms1_prune
params.description: Drop MS1 peaks at or below trace:noise_threshold_int while loading, which saves memory. false keeps every peak.

params.name: perf:trace_bands
params.description: Trace each window's fragments in this many m/z bands in parallel, for more parallelism than the window count gives. Changes the output. 1 = off; 0 = auto (the output then depends on the thread count; the integer detector refuses it with tile:rt_sec > 0 or a streamed .d).

params.name: perf:mem_fraction
params.description: Fraction of free memory the window loop may use, re-checked for every window: MemAvailable, or the headroom under a cgroup limit when lower (macOS: free plus inactive memory). One window always runs, however large.

params.name: perf:max_concurrent_windows
params.description: Most isolation windows processed at once; fewer use less memory but take longer. 0 = no cap (free memory still limits them).

params.name: perf:decode_threads
params.description: Threads that decode the Bruker frames (MS1 on the first read; MS2, sliced into the windows, when the run or a tile is read; diaPASEF). 0 = all threads on the first read and the window team's free threads on the tile reads; n = a team of n threads for both; 1 = serial. The spectra do not depend on it.

params.name: charge:min_charge
params.description: Lowest precursor charge written. Default 1: singly charged precursors are real 1+ ions but carry a higher FDR, so control FDR per charge downstream. 2 writes only 2+ and higher, the same spectra as at 1.

params.name: charge:im_charge_veto
params.description: Use ion mobility to correct charge calls: a 1+ call on the run's 2+ mobility trend is re-called 2+, one on the 3+ trend is dropped. Genuine 1+ ions keep their charge.

params.name: charge:im_veto_band
params.description: charge:im_charge_veto: half-width of the 2+ and 3+ mobility bands, in robust standard deviations of the fit.

params.name: charge:mono_profile_check
params.description: Check each precursor's monoisotope against the summed MS1 intensity at its isotope positions and move it by one isotope when averagine disagrees. 'v2' (default) = on; 'false' = off; 'v3' (experimental) = the monoisotope position with the best averagine cosine x observed fraction (Dinosaur/Monocle shift test).

params.name: charge:mono_position_min_ratio
params.description: charge:mono_profile_check v2: reject the lightest isotope when its averagine-scaled intensity ratio is below this; the monoisotope then moves one isotope heavier.

params.name: charge:mono_position_im_box
params.description: charge:mono_profile_check v2: 1/K0 half-width of the isotope intensity sums. 0 = auto (per run, 0.01 to 0.03).

params.name: charge:mono_position_extend
params.description: charge:mono_profile_check v2: when nothing was rejected, move the monoisotope one isotope lighter if that position's ratio is at least this. 0 = off.

params.name: charge:mono_position_iterate
params.description: charge:mono_profile_check v2: after a rejection, test the new lightest isotope too, and repeat. false tests once.

params.name: charge:iso_im_tolerance
params.description: 1/K0 tolerance for matching isotope partners. 0 (default) = measured per run (0.01 to 0.05); a value above 0 fixes it.

params.name: dnoise:ms1
params.description: Denoise every MS1 frame before peak picking, with a port of dnoise v0.1.0 (Garrett, Diedrich & Yates III, bioRxiv 2026.08.27.747603). Bruker .d input only; other inputs pass through. Lowers peak memory; false turns it off.

params.name: noims:min_corr
params.description: Non-IMS path: minimum fragment-precursor profile correlation.

params.name: noims:ppm
params.description: Non-IMS path: mass-trace and isotope m/z tolerance.
